name: afk
description: AFK skill chain for Claude Code — design pipeline (grill-requirements → prd → optional prototype → to-ticket → grill-solution → sdd → design-brief → optional grill-verification + to-verification-plan → subtasks) + executor (execute, interactive or driven) + hands-off driver (autopilot: subagent per subtask, adversarial execution gate, park-and-continue) + feature smoke gate (smoke-test: full or minimal) + code-learning artifact (understand: one self-contained interactive HTML explainer per feature, MR, or code area) + stakeholder demo script (to-demo-plan: a minute-budgeted beat-by-beat plan for demoing a delivered feature to POs and QA) for the Nakisa Jira/GitLab workflow.
